page_note: 该页为OECD报告第17页,含Figure 2.2的双面板图(左为2015-2024年合并申报总量堆积柱状图,右为OECD与非OECD年均增长率横向条形图)及下方注释、来源与正文段落。

heading.title: Total merger notifications (left) and the average annual growth rate (right) for OECD and Non-OECD jurisdictions, 2015-2024

components.evidence: left panel: each year bar has a dark OECD segment with a pink Non-OECD segment stacked on top
right panel: two bars, OECD and Non-OECD, side by side within each year-pair slot
right panel: labels 2015/2016 ... 2023/2024 on the y axis, bars run left and right
right panel bars for 2022/2023 and 2021/2022 extend left of the 0% line toward -20%
one figure number over a vertical stacked bar panel and a horizontal grouped bar panel
left panel 0 to 14 000 counts, right panel -30% to 50% growth
legend 'OECD Non-OECD' under left panel, separate legend under right panel
both legends sit in a row below their plot areas, outside them
left panel shows horizontal rules at 2 000 ... 14 000, no vertical rules
right panel shows vertical rules at -30% ... 50%, no horizontal rules
'Total number of merger notifications' over the left plot; its ticks read bare '14 000'
'Total number of merger notifications' printed above the 14 000 tick, not alongside the axis
'Note: Data based on the 59 jurisdictions in the OECD CompStats database...' then 'Source: OECD CompStats database'
right panel has 9 year-pair rows while the value axis ticks are every 10%

new_components.name: axis_title_in_legend_row
new_components.evidence: right panel legend row ends with 'Annual growth rate' with no colour swatch, acting as axis title
new_components.why_it_matters: 读数时必须意识到该项不是数据系列,否则会误认为右图有三个系列并错配数值。

new_components.name: panel_named_in_title_only
new_components.evidence: panels carry no titles; the caption says '(left)' and '(right)' to distinguish them
new_components.why_it_matters: 要定位某个数值属于哪个面板,只能从图标题中的 (left)/(right) 推断,表格行需自行补出面板键。

new_components.name: per_panel_category_axis
new_components.evidence: left panel categories are 2015-2024, right panel are nine year pairs 2015/2016-2023/2024
new_components.why_it_matters: 两个面板的类别轴不同,不能用同一套年份键跨面板寻址数值。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签,全部要靠像素对轴读取。左面板网格线间距为2 000,而待判定的Non-OECD分段本身只有约1 000–1 500,5%容差即±50–75,相当于网格间距的1/30,堆积段还须先读顶端总高再相减,误差叠加。右面板刻度每10%一格,3%和4%这两根短条的容差只有±0.15pp和±0.2pp,在150 dpi下条长仅十几像素,几乎无法区分。相比之下寻址(面板+系列+年份三键)与标题上下文虽也需补齐,但都能从页面文字逐字抄出。

suggestions.new_ablation_row: 有/无 panel_key 一行:当面板名只存在于图标题的 (left)/(right) 时,数值寻址准确率的变化

suggestions.where_to_change: 图例样式字段:允许一个无色块的文字项(此处为 'Annual growth rate')混入图例行
suggestions.new_ablation_row: 图例中含非系列文字项 vs 纯系列图例,对系列数识别与错配率的影响

suggestions.new_ablation_row: 单位短语位于轴上方 vs 位于轴标题旁,对数值量纲判定正确率的影响
